page_title: MAI 1-1 WER | Mainz v Werder Bremen 01/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Florian Badstubner has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+2' The substitution has been made. Niklas Stark (Werder Bremen) has replaced Romano Schmid.
90+2' Nikolas Veratschnig (Mainz) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Florian Badstubner didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
89' Here is a change. Paul Nebel is going off and Bo Henriksen gives the last tactical orders to Arnaud Nordin (Mainz).
89' The referee signals a substitution. Nelson Weiper (Mainz) is brought on as a substitute for Jae-Sung Lee.
88' The foul by Keke Topp (Werder Bremen) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Florian Badstubner.
86' 1 - 1 Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) finds his way to a high rebound and doesn't hesitate to blast it to the bottom right corner.
86' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Yukinari Sugawara (Werder Bremen), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Karim Coulibaly leaves the pitch and Isaac Schmidt (Werder Bremen) comes on.
77' Bo Henriksen decides to make a substitution. Phillipp Mwene will be replaced by Danny da Costa (Mainz).
77' Nikolas Veratschnig (Mainz) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Silvan Widmer.
69' Today's match ends for Benedict Hollerbach who will be replaced by Armindo Sieb (Mainz).

66' Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) pounces on a loose pass, cuts inside an opponent and unleashes a piledriver towards goal. The keeper scrambles to save the effort, but it curls just wide of the left post.
64' Horst Steffen has decided to make a change. Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) replaces Marco Grull.
64' Victor Boniface goes off the pitch and Keke Topp (Werder Bremen) comes on.
61' Paul Nebel (Mainz) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
59' Florian Badstubner shows a yellow card to Karim Coulibaly (Werder Bremen), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.

53' Mio Backhaus makes a brilliant save! Benedict Hollerbach (Mainz) easily weaves through the defence and unleashes a shot from just outside of the box. His low shot goes towards the middle of the goal but is saved by keeper!

48' Lennard Maloney (Mainz) rose high to meet a perfectly taken corner kick and attempted to steer a fine header from inside the box towards the left side of the goal. Nobody knows what would have happened if one of the defending players hadn’t pulled off a brilliant intervention to block the effort.
47' Mainz have been awarded a corner kick.
46' Horst Steffen has made a change at the break. Cameron Puertas (Werder Bremen) has come on in place of Samuel Mbangula.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45+1' Mainz couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Mio Backhaus (Werder Bremen) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Florian Badstubner had an easy-decision to make.
43' Samuel Mbangula (Werder Bremen) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
40' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
36' 1 - 0 Silvan Widmer (Mainz) collects a sweet pass inside the box and fires the ball into the roof of the net. What a clinical finish!
36' Silvan Widmer (Mainz) decided to shoot after receiving a sweet pass. If it wasn't for Mio Backhaus's superb save the ball would have probably ended up in the bottom right corner.
34' Paul Nebel (Mainz) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
32' The Werder Bremen players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
26' OFF THE BAR! Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) unleashes a thunderous effort from the edge of the box and the ball crashes off the woodwork. What a strike that was!
22' Victor Boniface (Werder Bremen) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
13' A neat pass is well received by Marco Grull (Werder Bremen), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball on goal. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
6' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Mio Backhaus, who pulls off a comfortable save!
5' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Werder Bremen will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Florian Badstubner.
